Pepper's Museum Shock

A Tale of 28 Wonders — Reviewer Preview

For Reviewers

Note: The opening page of this preview is a quick welcome note for museum partners; the illustrated story begins on the following page.

Pepper stepped through the giant museum doors and gasped. The lobby was as big as the sky!

Ruff! Pepper stopped dead in her tracks. What in the world was that giant skeleton looming ahead?

Wonder number one: a towering T-Rex! A friendly hand lifted Pepper up so she wouldn't miss a single bone.

Wonder ten: a famous lady with a mysterious smile. Pepper smiled right back, wondering if the painting liked dogs.

22 more wonders are waiting inside — from a spinning globe to a real steam engine, a rainbow of stained glass, and Pepper's very own museum nap!
